item.title: Russia's war in Ukraine: the situation
item.description:

Russia sent a major business delegation to Kabul for talks with the Taliban and Azerbaijan increased its European engagement at the EPC Summit. Ukraine launched a mass attack on Odesa Oblast and struck a Russian airfield in Astrakhan and a drone launch site in Oryol, while a drone attack in Rostov killed one and injured four. Rayana, a female drone operator, was killed fighting Russian forces. There were 75,767 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
